programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.sub_title: The Slings and Arrows of Outrageous Lockers
programs.desc: The city of Hemet reminds Kenny of a certain English poet, but he ends up focusing on the Eastern arts; Ivy spreads holiday joy as he battles it out with a new buyer who isn't all that intimidated.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: In West Covina, Dusty uses magic to find his treasure; Lisa, determined to make her carpenter father proud, looks for something to refurbish and ends up channeling something else; Ivy wrestles with heels and tools, while Brandi gets in the ring to honor her grandpa.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: Bathed in the heat of Moreno Valley, Kenny has difficulty with names, so he calls an audible; Brandi can't catch a break without some help from above; Dave gets stuck with the business end of an unsatisfying locker; Dusty and Lupe put their "street" smarts to good use.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: Back in Montebello, Kenny is determined to stop swearing by carrying around a cuss counter; Dave goes in big on a high-end locker; Ivy doesn't hit the bullseye when it counts; Dusty and Lupe hope to hear the pristine sounds of success.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.sub_title: It's a Brew-tiful Day in Fullerton
programs.desc: Lisa keeps getting her lockers taken from her, and it makes her hopping mad; Kenny goes in for a banjo but comes out with a harmonica; Dusty and Lupe find the locker of her dreams; Ivy finds a vehicle in his locker, just not the one he expected.

programs.title: Storage Wars
programs.desc: The buyers return to Moreno Valley, where an old friend surprises them; Dusty & Lupe do their best to hit it out of the park; Ivy finds a couple of "less scary" coffins; Brandi isn't going to let anything ruin her bright and sunny attitude.
